baseline_types.synthetic: Designed conversations with preset ground truth for validation
baseline_types.naturalistic: Real conversations without preset targets, evaluated by consensus

embedding_backends.e5: E5-large fine-tuned on S64 corpus (768 dims, structural matching)

B1.name: Surface Deception
B1.design_intent: Test false positive resistance (transformation-like language without depth)

B2.name: Implicit Transformation
B2.design_intent: Test detection of subtle, metaphorical changes

B3.name: Rapid Oscillation
B3.design_intent: Test detection of fast, explicit state changes

B4.name: Stuck States
B4.design_intent: Test detection of incomplete transformations (T1 without T2)

B5.name: Nested Complexity
B5.design_intent: Test detection of multi-level simultaneous transformations

B6.name: Outcome Ambiguity
B6.design_intent: Test process vs. outcome discrimination (domain disambiguation)

B7.name: Failed Transformation
B7.design_intent: Test detection of temporary change with reversion

B8.name: False Completion
B8.design_intent: Test detection of claimed transformation contradicted by evidence

B9.name: Self-Discovery Conversation (JJJS)
B9.description: Authentic therapeutic self-discovery conversation across 4 thematic sessions
